cases.nl_cmd: blade-ai inject -i "On <app-host>, make the Python Redis client throw redis.exceptions.ConnectionError with message chaos drill: redis unavailable for command <cmd> for <timeout> seconds"

params.name: app-host
params.description: 目标 Python 应用所在主机或 Agent 地址，对应 -n <app-host>

params.name: exception
params.description: Exception class name thrown by the matched Redis command.

params.name: exception-message
params.description: Exception message thrown by the matched Redis command.

params.name: cmd
params.description: Redis command to match; empty affects all Redis commands.

params.name: timeout
params.description: Experiment duration in seconds.

cases.use_case_name: 缓存不可用 导致 Python_Redis异常
cases.structured_cmd: blade-ai inject --scope python --target redis --action throwCustomException -n <app-host> --params exception=redis.exceptions.ConnectionError,exception-message=chaos drill: redis unavailable,cmd=<cmd>,timeout=<timeout>

cases.title: Redis cache null return
cases.symptom: Matched Python Redis reads return a tampered None value without errors, potentially causing cache penetration or invalid application behavior.
cases.case_path: references/catalogue/Python_Redis返回值篡改/Python_Redis返回值篡改_缓存返回空值.md
cases.nl_cmd: blade-ai inject -i "Make the prepared Python Redis client on <app-host> return null for Redis command <cmd> on key <key> for <timeout> seconds without raising errors."

params.name: app-host
params.description: Python application host or process selected by the prepared Python blade agent.

params.name: return-value
params.description: Value returned by intercepted Redis commands; null is parsed as Python None.

params.name: cmd
params.description: Redis command to match so only selected Redis commands are tampered.

params.name: key
params.description: Redis key to match to narrow the tampering scope.

params.name: timeout
params.description: Automatic experiment duration in seconds.

cases.use_case_name: 缓存返回空值 导致 Python_Redis返回值篡改
cases.structured_cmd: blade-ai inject --scope python --target redis --action returnValue -n <app-host> --params return-value=null,cmd=<cmd>,key=<key>,timeout=<timeout>

cases.title: Python gRPC delay
cases.symptom: Python gRPC unary client calls are delayed by a fixed injected latency, causing increased latency or DEADLINE_EXCEEDED when deadlines are shorter.
cases.case_path: references/catalogue/Python_gRPC延迟/Python_gRPC延迟_微服务调用超时.md
cases.nl_cmd: blade-ai inject -i "Add <time> milliseconds delay to Python gRPC unary calls on <app-host>, optionally matching service <service> and method <method>, with jitter <offset> and auto-stop after <timeout> seconds"

params.name: app-host
params.description: Host where the prepared Python application process runs

params.name: time
params.description: Delay in milliseconds added to matched gRPC unary calls

params.name: service
params.description: gRPC service name to match; omit to affect all unary gRPC calls

params.name: method
params.description: Full gRPC method path to match, e.g. /pkg.Svc/Method

params.name: offset
params.description: Random jitter in milliseconds added on top of time

params.name: timeout
params.description: Automatic experiment end time in seconds

cases.use_case_name: 微服务调用超时 导致 Python_gRPC延迟
cases.structured_cmd: blade-ai inject --scope python --target grpc --action delay -n <app-host> --params time=<time>,service=<service>,method=<method>,offset=<offset>,timeout=<timeout>
